description: Source code for the CodeMirror Tern integration, providing a wrapper class CodeMirror.TernServer with methods for code assistance features such as autocompletion, go-to-definition, renaming, and argument hints, along with internal utility functions and worker thread management.

classes.name: CodeMirror.TernServer
classes.description: Main class providing code assistance features by wrapping a Tern server, managing documents, and handling user interactions.

methods.name: addDoc
methods.description: Adds a document to the Tern server and sets up change tracking.

methods.name: delDoc
methods.description: Removes a document from the Tern server.

methods.name: hideDoc
methods.description: Hides a document and sends it if it has changes.

methods.name: showType
methods.description: Shows type information at a position.

methods.name: jumpToDef
methods.description: Navigates to the definition of the symbol at cursor.

methods.name: jumpBack
methods.description: Returns to previous location after jump.

methods.name: selectName
methods.description: Selects all references of the symbol.

methods.name: request
methods.description: Sends a request to the Tern server.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Cleans up resources and terminates worker if used.
